lede: The most consequential thing on the calendar this week is Wednesday's joint work session where the Planning Commission and BOCC sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code amendments touching forestry, oil and gas, deep geothermal, and condominium plats — no final votes, but this is where the shape of those changes gets decided. Also Wednesday, the commissioners make a rare trip to Norwood to consider a Planning Commission appointment and hear results from the Placerville Fire Survey. In between, the Ecology Commission digs into the 2022 Climate Action Plan with a focus on transportation and consumption.

notable.stake: Land Use Code amendments on forestry, oil/gas, geothermal, and condo plats being shaped.
